'''Molly''' (Japanese: '''モリー ''' ''Molly'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[XY020|Breaking Titles at the Chateau!]]''. She is a {{tc|Maid}} working at the [[Battle Chateau]]. Her tasks include welcoming guests, refereeing the {{pkmn|battle}}s, and awarding {{pkmn|Trainer}}s with new ranks.

When {{Ash}}, {{ashfr}}, [[Nico]], and [[Chester]] came to visit the Battle Chateau, Molly welcomed them in the hall. She and the head of the Battle Chateau, Duke [[Turner]], led the group to the Chateau's salon, which acts as a meeting place for Trainers. Afterwards, she refereed the battles between Nico and [[Farrell]], Ash and Chester, and [[Viola]] and [[Grant]].
